title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Payment Plans: Returned-Payment Rule
content:
**Rule.** The returned-payment rule of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program payment plan takes payments away according to the family payments on the enrollment that the bank returned within a 12-month window. A return counts when it posted after the same day of the month 12 months before the day of the payment, and on or before the day of the payment. When that earlier month has no such day, the last day of that month is used. Payments are taken away as follows:

- two or more returned: **two payments** taken away;
- exactly one returned: **one payment** taken away;
- none returned: **none** taken away.

Returned payments are the returned-payment entries on this enrollment's billing history. A payment returned on a sibling's enrollment does not count here.

## Examples (hypothetical payment day of October 15)

| Returned payments on the enrollment | Counted? | Payments taken away |
|---|---|---|
| one posted October 15 of the previous year | no, the window starts after that day | none |
| one posted October 16 of the previous year | yes | 1 |
| one posted in the previous November and one posted on October 15, the day of the payment | yes, both | 2 |
| one two years ago | no | none |
